## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to see in Déngé.

## Problem Statement / Motivation

Is your feature request related to a specific problem or inconvenience?
> Example: "It would be really helpful if..." or "I often find myself needing..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of how you imagine this feature working from a user's perspective.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions, apps, or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context / Mockups

Add any other context, wireframes, screenshots, or design ideas about the feature request here.
